questions,answered
When will I see results?

Many users notice brighter skin within 2 weeks. Dark spots and tone usually improve visibly in 4 to 8 weeks of daily use, depending on how deep the pigmentation is.

Why is the new formula so thin?

The liposomal delivery system needs a water-light base to carry Alpha Arbutin deeper into skin. The actives are lab verified at 5% Niacinamide and 2% Alpha Arbutin by HPLC assay.

Is it suitable for oily, acne-prone skin?

Yes. Niacinamide helps control excess oil, and the formula is tested non-comedogenic.

Can I use it with Vitamin C or retinol?

Layer it with Deconstruct Oil-Free Moisturizer and a sunscreen in the day. Introduce one new active at a time, and patch test before combining.

Do I need sunscreen with it?

Yes. Daily sunscreen prevents new pigmentation and protects your results.

Full ingredient list

Aqua, Niacinamide, Alpha Arbutin, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Tocopheryl Acetate, Dictyopteris Membranacea, Pentylene Glycol, Propanediol, Phenoxyethanol and Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium PCA, Trehalose, Disodium EDTA, Sodium Metabisulphite, Sodium Anisate.
